candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders; gateway checkout propagates these as 502s. Traces show order spans failing with 500 Internal Server Error for every checkout correlation, and gateway metrics show 16 502s vs 2.7 200s on /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause inside order (db, payment, inventory) not established; order-side logs/traces excluded.

report.explanation: Gateway 502s on /v1/checkout are caused by order service returning 500 on POST /v1/orders, confirmed by correlated traces and gateway metrics. The specific fault within order is not yet bounded, so the candidate is scoped to the observed http-500 propagation.
missing_evidence: Order service logs/traces for the failing /v1/orders requests to identify the internal error source
Order dependency metrics (postgresql, payment, inventory) to rule out db-pool-exhaustion or downstream-latency
